title: Jester on the Dark Pier
description: A demonic jester in a red and blue harlequin suit with glowing blue orbs on his chest and hands crouches on a wooden pier. Behind him stand multiple shadowy top-hatted figures while a cracked moon with a screaming bloody face floats over dark water, with a gothic city skyline under a fiery orange and purple stormy sky filled with lightning and magical energy.
prompt: A demonic clown jester with white face paint and red grin, wearing a vibrant red and blue harlequin costume with glowing blue orbs on chest and hands, crouching dynamically on a wooden pier over dark water. Multiple shadowy figures in black top hats stand behind him. A large cracked moon with a screaming bloody face appears in the sky. Distant gothic spired city skyline under a dramatic orange and purple stormy sky with lightning bolts and swirling magical energy trails. Cinematic surreal horror fantasy style.
